metadata.description: Agent Skills for working with Skardi — SQL pipelines as HTTP endpoints. Teaches AI coding agents Skardi's patterns for building searchable context, hybrid search, graph queries, and connectors.

plugins.description: Build searchable context over documents or your own datastore, answer questions from live data, and query a property graph through SQL. Bundles the auto-context, retrieval, graph-source, graph-rag, and document-cache skills.
